title: espos.json (an EspOS package project)
description: Tells `espos build` what goes into the package. Without espos.json, a folder with manifest.json is packed the way tools/espk.py packs it: every file except dotfiles and manifest.json.

main.description: The app's code (kind js). A .ts entry, or any entry with "bundle": true, is bundled with esbuild (its imports included) into main.js; a .js entry is copied as main.js.

files.description: Files or folders copied into the package as they are (icon.jpg, game.jar, data/...). Paths keep their place: "data" becomes data/... in the package.
